description: A discriminating documentation case: the change is a real, correct paging fix (over-fetch by one to answer hasMore, replacing a length === 50 test that could not tell a full last page from a truncated one), and it adds a docstring whose every line is recoverable from the signature. Nothing about that docstring is false or stale, which is what makes it invisible to the correctness pass and a genuine test of the documentation lens. Two must-not-flag traps sit in the same diff: the append-only rationale that justifies offset paging, and the over-fetch rationale that justifies limit + 1.
